integrity: Analytical minimax proof; exact independent enumeration is corroborative and not treated as a continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two agents and three goods, nonnegative additive values, irrevocable online allocation with current item values observed; no generalization to larger markets or to expected approximate-EFX ratio is asserted. Source comparisons identify no exact matching online theorem but cannot exclude unindexed priority.
title: The sharp one-half online EFX probability for two agents and three goods
